description: Accessibility baseline allowlist for the Luxora web E2E axe audit. EMPTY by policy: the E2E gate fails on every critical/serious WCAG 2.x A/AA violation. Add an exception only with Lead approval and always include a reason, e.g. {"state": "app-conversation", "rule": "color-contrast", "selector": "[data-testid=...]", "reason": "large display text meets 3:1 per WCAG 1.4.3 exception"}. Matching: rule is required; state and selector are optional (selector = substring of an axe target).
